tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get complete schema.org entity data by URL (its @id), including relationships the graph holds in either direction.

tools.name: query_relationships
tools.description: Find entities connected to a subject: one row per property value, with object_type 'uri' for links to other entities and 'literal' for values. Optionally filter by predicate.

tools.name: find_by_type
tools.description: Find all entities of a specific schema.org type (exact type name, for example Service, Person, DefinedTerm).

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Substring search across the text of every entity; returns up to 20 entity URLs.

tools.name: fuzzy_find_and_traverse
tools.description: Find and rank schema.org entities from natural language, tolerating typos and alternative names. Returns bounded entity context with relationship IDs; use get_entity for full detail.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_entity" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
